answer: Counterparty diversity blocks bulk fakes: full rewards need trades with 12 independent partners over 20 epochs, publicly checked. A ferrous lock ties each account to one funding source, so clones are exposed. Copies cannot bridge to partners, as peers refuse repeat trades from one source. Fakes stay on a narrow ledge. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits at 50 units, 5,000 units. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
